data.name: Fadilah
data.gender_notes: Fadilah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Fadilah is an Arabic name that means virtuous and moral. It is a name that signifies good character and ethics. The name Fadilah carries the meaning “Virtuous, Moral” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fadilah usually hope their child will grow to embody virtuous, moral and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Fadilah is a name that reflects the Islamic values of being virtuous and moral, as mentioned in the Quran.
data.etymology: Fadilah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Virtuous, Moral.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fadilah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_urdu.name: فضیلہ
in_urdu.meaning: رفعت و عزت والی، اچھائی و خوبی کی علامت
